structure: One folder per constituent institute (e.g. ITNU, IMNU, IOP, IOS, IOL, IOA, IOC, IOD, IDS, FoDSR). Each institute folder holds separate JSON files: faculty.json, fees.json, placements.json, academic_calendar.json, syllabus.json, events.json, clubs.json.

institutes_identified.name: Faculty of Doctoral Studies and Research

known_constraints: nirmauni.ac.in (the root domain) blocks automated fetching via robots.txt — only search-engine snippets are usable from it, not full pages/PDFs.
Institute-level subdomains (e.g. technology.nirmauni.ac.in, cse.nirmauni.ac.in, ei.nirmauni.ac.in) ARE fetchable and contain faculty directories, placement stats, and fee pages.

Instagram pages cannot be crawled by this tool (no login/API access) — any Instagram-sourced event data would need to be supplied by the user (screenshots/exports) or gathered via public web search snippets only.

Detailed per-subject syllabus with credit-hour breakdowns lives in PDFs under each department's 'Academics > Curriculum' pages on the institute subdomains — fetchable, but there are hundreds of them (one per branch per semester); needs to be pulled department-by-department.

Year-by-year, company-by-company, position-and-package-level placement data is NOT fully public — official pages publish aggregate highs/averages and top recruiter lists, not a full company x package x student matrix. Where third-party sites (Shiksha, CollegeDunia, Careers360) report figures, they sometimes conflict — flagged as such below.

Campus map with building-to-building walking directions is not published as structured/GPS data anywhere found so far — only a static campus map image on the admissions site. Would need manual annotation.
